scope: Actual first serialized provider request schema observation, no raw thinking; not Task/Goal behavior success.

tasklist_function.name: keeper_tasks_list
tasklist_function.description: List backlog tasks. Rows carry id, title, priority, created_at, status, assignee and lifecycle timestamps; projection=full adds completion notes, description, files, contract, handoff_context, execution_links. awaiting_verification means the task awaits the completion-authority verdict and no Keeper can claim it; never Read producer sandbox paths. Rows are ordered by priority, then created_at, then id. When truncated is true the response carries next_cursor; pass it as cursor with the same status, include_done and projection to read the rows after that page. The last page has none. new_tasks highlights recent off-page rows only on the first page; continuation pages do not repeat that discovery window. Narrow by task_ids, assignee, goal_id or a literal query before paging; all supplied filters are ANDed and must stay the same on continuation pages. Use task_ids with projection=full for known tasks instead of scanning the whole backlog. Exact task_ids lookups include every lifecycle state when status and include_done are both omitted; general discovery excludes done and cancelled tasks. Explicit lifecycle filters keep their stated meaning.

task_ids.description: Exact task IDs to retrieve in one call. With status and include_done both omitted, returns requested tasks in every lifecycle state, including done and cancelled. Explicit lifecycle filters still apply.

assignee.description: Exact performer handle: includes claimed, in_progress, awaiting_verification and done tasks allowed by the status filter. Does not match a canceller or unassigned task.

goal_id.description: Exact Goal ID from the authoritative task-to-Goal link registry. No links returns an empty list; an unreadable registry returns an error.

query.description: Non-blank literal substring in title or description, ASCII case-insensitive. No regex, semantic ranking, notes or receipt search.

include_done.description: Explicit false excludes done and cancelled; true includes done but excludes cancelled. An explicit status takes precedence. When omitted, exact task_ids lookups include every state; general discovery excludes done and cancelled.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous truncated keeper_tasks_list response. Pass it with the same status, include_done and projection to read the rows after that page. A cursor from a different filter, or one this tool did not issue, is rejected with field=cursor.

if_revision.description: Optional producer revision from the previous keeper_tasks_list snapshot; matching revisions return unchanged.
